value.rationale: The exact half-leakage turning-point 2-cycle is a natural dynamical/Markov boundary, not an arbitrary numerical slice. It distinguishes true finite-parameter coarse Markovization from small-leakage asymptotics and from the known q non-Markov sign example; the strictly positive directed sign–position covariance and hidden (-1/9)^n mode reveal microscopic temporal information invisible to either autocorrelation. The precise finite-parameter statistic is a useful benchmark and motivates diagnostics of coarse-graining.
